stratified_error.definition: Schematic stored-raster apertures; all enrolled group members. Clear: minimum detail >=0.30; smooth: minimum detail in [0.05,0.30). Both need >=96px, range>=0.10 and code-tail fractions<0.20. Engineering demonstration selected using three source-only development probes, not human recommendations.

measurement_policy.routing: one simultaneous match; zero or multiple matches withhold deployment
measurement_policy.aperture: explicit integer xyxy half-open source rectangle; omission means full stored raster
measurement_policy.enrollment: all declared group members, including prospectively excluded observation cases

admission_policy.sampling_design: Deterministic branch/containment control. No population interpretation; does not establish real sampling assumptions.
